assets.name: 路面
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Regenerate this road texture with HORIZONTAL RECTANGULAR BRICKS, keeping this exact palette and cute simple top-down cartoon style. The reference is too square. Keep EXACTLY FOUR horizontal rows, but use EXACTLY TWO complete brick widths across each row, so each full brick is TWICE AS WIDE AS IT IS TALL. Square canvas 1024x1024. Approximately 8 full 2:1 rectangular brick areas in total. NOT square blocks, NOT 4 columns, NOT 8 rows. Mandatory half-brick stagger: rows 1 and 3 have joints at x=0,512,1024; rows 2 and 4 have joints at x=256,768 with matching cropped HALF BRICKS on left and right. Horizontal joints at y=0,256,512,768,1024.
This is a seamless repeating MATERIAL texture. Opposite edges must join exactly when identical copies are placed in a grid without flips or rotation. Top and bottom image edges have exactly matching narrow HALF-width grout strips, same uniform color, so the total joint equals the internal grout width. Left/right cut-off half-bricks continue with exactly the same color, contour, shine and shading, no discontinuity. The TWO half-bricks on the left and right of each offset row must be the SAME color. Do not round or outline the image boundary; round the small internal corners of individual bricks only.
Thin soft low-contrast grout, very restrained broad internal highlights, quiet smooth cartoon faces. NO chunky bevel, NO directional gradient across the image, NO peripheral shadow, NO blank margin, NO border, NO framing, NO text, NO perspective, NO texture grain, NO tiny clutter. Only the paving surface, fill the entire opaque square. Prioritize correct horizontal rectangular running-bond layout and seamless opposite edges. Keep the original map's palette. Alternate pale sandy beige and vanilla cream rectangular bricks, thin soft warm beige grout. Odd-row edge halves must both have exactly the SAME sand/cream color, never mismatched. Gentle cream highlights, no dark brown ridges. Production asset harbor_market/road.

assets.name: 墙体
assets.prompt: Input image role: geometry reference showing existing top-down wall grid blocks. Create ONE SINGLE wall-block tile for ONE 32x32 game grid cell, based on the reference's individual square block. Output a square opaque RGB bitmap, ideally1024x1024, with one large plain square wall-top face filling almost the whole canvas. It must NOT contain a row of bricks, multiple tiles, running-bond masonry or a wall surface pattern. Match this geometry: full dark base fills all32x32 cell; one subtly rounded top cap inset about1px left/right and1px top, top cap height about26px; narrow darker solid bottom band about5px creates a shallow raised wall-block effect. Very small light line across top edge, subtle side bevel. Exact top-down 2D orthographic wall-cap icon, no isometric cube and no perspective. warm ivory top, pale seafoam rim and muted sage-blue bottom band. Cute cozy gentle cartoon art, simple matte flat colors, clean warm outlines, no spots, no grain, no realistic texture, no glossy candy reflections. Entire image must be filled and completely opaque RGB, including corner pixels outside the slightly rounded cap, where the darker base color fills in. No blank space, transparency, outer margin, shadow cast outside the block, labels, lettering, floor, plants or background scenery. This one square asset will be drawn once per wall grid cell to form horizontal walls, vertical walls and corners. Production asset harbor_market/wall.
